The Hot Big Bang is an empirically established physical description of cosmic history from $t \sim 0.1\text{ s}$ ($T \sim 10\text{ MeV}$, $z \sim 10^9$) to the present epoch ($t_0 = 13.787 \pm 0.020\text{ Gyr}$, $z = 0$). It is anchored by five independent observational pillars:
